title: 原创多尺度遮挡场景

source.text: 浅色背景上的原创平涂场景包含五个大小不同、位置不规则的形状：左上紫色圆环、右上橙色竖向胶囊形、横跨中部和下部的蓝色不规则四边形、左下珊瑚色横条，以及右下较小的绿色星形。珊瑚色横条覆盖蓝色形状的一部分。圆环中央开口呈背景色。图中未提供物理比例尺、材料、功能、真实物品来源或发生时间。
source.notes: One independently authored language-neutral scene, reused in Chinese and English. Original Pillow generator and visible-support pixel records are in assets/. Five unequal, irregularly placed shapes include partial occlusion; no third-party image, real photo, or image model was used. Reviewer annotations are not generation context. This synthetic scene does not establish natural-image generalization.

references.title: Original five-shape occlusion scene; deterministic repository-native generator, MIT
